title: March for SZFE autonomy and freedom of education
location: Budapest: Műegyetem rakpart through central Pest, crossing Liberty Bridge and continuing toward SZFE/Uránia
organizer: SZFE students; exact formal co-organizer roster is reported differently across sources
participants_original: Contemporaneous reports describe several thousand/many thousands; RFE/RL reports around 10,000. Methods behind qualitative and numeric estimates are not reconciled.
threshold_50_evidence: Three contemporary reports describe several/many thousands or about 10,000 in the single Budapest march; well above 50 despite unresolved exact count.

start_date.summary: Contemporaneous reports date the march to Oct 23.

location.summary: Reports place route from Technical University/Műegyetem toward downtown, Liberty Bridge and SZFE/Uránia.

organizer.summary: Student organizers from SZFE; solidarity groups participated.

demands.summary: Academic autonomy, free education, and opposition to government restructuring/centralization.

participants.summary: Qualitative mass scale established; exact number and estimate provenance unresolved.

state_response.summary: No relevant response dimensions stated in captured event passages.

notes: Distinct dated street march during a September-start occupation. Do not infer event continuity from occupation alone.
open_questions: State-response and protester-violence dimensions remain unknown.

title: Car demonstration against state-media propaganda at MTVA
location: MTVA headquarters, Kunigunda útja, Óbuda, Budapest
organizer: Independent MPs Ákos Hadházy and Bernadett Szél
participants_original: Telex reports a few hundred; no exact count.
threshold_50_evidence: Contemporary Telex body says a few hundred attended the action at the MTVA building.

start_date.summary: Article title and content refer to Oct 23, 2020.

location.summary: At MTVA premises in Óbuda/Kunigunda útja.

organizer.summary: Independent opposition MPs Hadházy and Szél organized the action.

participants.summary: Telex reports a few hundred, sufficient for 50 threshold but approximate.

state_response.summary: Telex says police road closures contributed to a difficult start; arrests, force and dispersal not reported.

notes: Separate action from the student march occurring on the same date.
open_questions: Police closure detail is not mapped to a specific codebook response category.
Exact crowd count and post-action response unknown.

title: Torch relay for university autonomy from Budapest to five university cities
location: Relay started at SZFE in Budapest and was planned to arrive in Debrecen, Pécs, Kaposvár, Szeged and Eger
organizer: SZFE students; formal event organizer not identified in the opened announcement
participants_original: 24.hu announced 150 runners across 1,100 km; local arrival crowds unknown. A Szeged.hu search result reports arrival in five cities but its body did not render in tool output.
threshold_50_evidence: No single-city public gathering count is established; total planned relay runners across all locations cannot resolve local threshold.

start_date.summary: 24.hu announcement dated Oct 3 schedules relay that day.

location.summary: Announcement lists five destinations; local result headline says torch reached cities, but body was not usefully rendered.

demands.summary: University autonomy and freedom of higher education.

participants.summary: 150 runners is a total route figure, not a city crowd count.

state_response.summary: Neither source reports state response or protester violence.

notes: Regional/sectoral lead retained without imputing relay total to any one gathering.
open_questions: Local attendance at each city arrival unresolved.
Actual relay details rely partly on a search-result header because local article body output had no rendered lines.

title: Greenpeace 65-hour demonstration calling for climate action
location: In front of the Carmelite monastery / Prime Minister’s office, Budapest
organizer: Greenpeace Hungary, joined by climate activists, scientists and artists
participants_original: No attendee count. Reports identify named speakers/participants and say more people joined; approximately 5,000 online letters are a separate campaign and not attendance.
threshold_50_evidence: Public physical demonstration is confirmed, but sources do not quantify on-site turnout; threshold unresolved.

start_date.summary: Started Monday, Oct 12, according to organizer and Euronews.

end_date.summary: Both describe a 65-hour action from Monday to Wednesday; exact end time is not captured.

location.summary: At the Carmelite/Prime Minister’s office in Budapest.

organizer.summary: Greenpeace Hungary organized with activists and public supporters.

demands.summary: Asked PM/government to adopt climate measures and support an ambitious EU emissions goal.

participants.summary: Named scientists/artists and additional joiners are described; count absent.

notes: Physical demonstration and domestic government policy target established; participation threshold cannot be inferred from online messages or rotating named speakers.
open_questions: Police/state response and protester violence unknown.
